_comment: Dedicated tsconfig consumed by design-sync's esbuild path-resolution plugin (compilerOptions.paths only). Targets are ABSOLUTE so they resolve regardless of the bundler's PKG_DIR base. Order matters: exact keys and more specific prefixes precede @/* so component/context/api imports route to the .jsx mirror, stubs and Next.js stubs, not the raw .js sources. @/lib/api is pinned to a stub because both lib/api.js and lib/api/ (a dir) exist and the plugin would mis-grab the directory.
